paraphrase: Right view is also understanding the four nutriments that sustain beings — edible food, contact, mental volition and consciousness — their origin in craving, their cessation and the way.

paraphrase: Right view is understanding each link of dependent origination — ageing-and-death, birth, becoming, clinging, craving, feeling, contact, the six sense bases, name-and-form, consciousness, formations, ignorance — its origin, cessation and the way to its cessation (the noble eightfold path).

paraphrase: Right view is understanding the unwholesome (killing … wrong view) and its roots — greed, hatred and delusion — and the wholesome and its roots; so understanding, one abandons the underlying tendency to lust, removes aversion, extirpates the view and conceit 'I am', and makes an end of suffering here and now.

paraphrase: Ignorance originates from the effluents and the effluents from ignorance: the three effluents of sensuality, becoming and ignorance, their origin, cessation and the way.
